newsitem.title: USA: Converse says wins suit against Apex sellers.
newsitem.headline: Converse says wins suit against Apex sellers.

text.p: Converse Inc said Tuesday that a jury ruled unanimously in its favor in connection with a lawsuit it brought against four former owners of Apex One Inc, a company it bought in June 1995 but which later sought bankruptcy protection.
The athletic footwear maker said the jury awarded it $25.6 million for alleged breach of warranty and other claims it lodged against the defendants.
However, it said that due to contractual provisions in the Apex purchase agreement and certain other agreements, the award would amount to about $13.7 million.
As a result of an agreement between Converse and another Apex seller, Converse said it expects to be paid an additional $2.0 million.
Converse said it did not know at this time whether any of the defendants would pursue any post-trial motions or appeals.
